item.title: Colombia Air Tragedy: Plane crashes minutes after takeoff; All 15 onboard killed
item.description: A SATENA government aircraft crashed minutes after takeoff in Colombia’s Norte de Santander province, killing all 15 people on board. The plane lost contact with air traffic control shortly after departing Cucuta for Ocana and went down in a hilly area near the Venezuela border. Rescue teams confirmed no survivors.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear plea challenging UGC regulations 2026 today; Details here
item.description: The Supreme Court will hear a crucial petition challenging the UGC Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions Regulations, 2026. The plea seeks a stay on certain provisions, alleging discrimination against the general category and violation of fundamental rights.

item.title: Gold tops Rs 1.75 Lakh, Silver crosses Rs 4 lakh on safe-haven rush; Know why prices are skyrocketing
item.description: Gold and silver prices continued their record-breaking rally as safe-haven demand surged amid geopolitical tensions, a firm US Federal Reserve stance, and a weaker dollar. In India, gold crossed ₹1.75 lakh per 10 grams, while silver breached ₹4 lakh per kg for the first time.

item.title: Indian Stock Market slides as Rupee hits record low against Dollar; Investors turn cautious
item.description: Indian equity markets opened lower on January 29 as weak global cues and a sharp fall in the rupee dented investor sentiment. The Sensex dropped over 250 points while the Nifty slipped below 25,300.

item.title: FIR Filed Against Ranveer Singh Over Alleged Insult to Bhoota Kola Tradition at IFFI Event
item.description: Bengaluru police have registered a case against actor Ranveer Singh following allegations that his performance at an international film event mocked sacred Bhoota Kola rituals, hurting the religious sentiments of devotees in Coastal Karnataka.

item.title: DN Exclusive | Explained: How the Sambhal Violence Case Has Reached the High Court
item.description: The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Vibhanshu Sudhir, passed the order on January 9 on a plea by Yameen, whose son was injured in the unrest. He alleged police shot his 24-year-old son on November 24, 2024. The court ordered an FIR against the accused officers.

item.title: Is Rubina Dilaik pregnant? Her latest post sparks speculation
item.description: TV actress Rubina Dilaik set social media abuzz by sharing a short Instagram video hinting she might be pregnant again. In the clip, she says, “I’m pregnant,” just two years after the birth of her twin daughters with husband Abhinav Shukla.

item.title: Negotiate or Face the Wrath: Trump threatens Iran with ‘Far Worse’ attack, China rebukes US
item.description: In a fresh war of words, Donald Trump has again threatened Iran with a devastating attack if it refuses to negotiate a deal. Without naming the US, China has berated Washington for its “military adventurism.” Meanwhile, Hezbollah has issued an “Axis of Resistance” warning to the US, threatening retaliation in case of any strike against Iran.

item.title: Ajit Pawar Plane Crash: Black box recovered from Baramati; Sent for investigation
item.description: The chartered flight that going to Baramati from Mumbai, crashed at 8:45 am on Wednesday, killing all five people on board. The victims included Dy CM Ajit Pawar, his personal security officer, an air hostess, and two crew members.

item.title: MoCA initiates swift investigation following Baramati Plane Crash involving Ajit Pawar
item.description: Following the tragic Baramati plane crash involving Ajit Pawar, according to the Ministry of Civil Aviation, MoCA promptly deployed AAIB and DGCA teams, recovered the black box, and initiated a thorough, transparent investigation under SOPs and AAIB Rules, 2025.
